title: Initial replacement stage with prescribed degree-zero sieve
statement: Let X be qcqs, K an etale hypercover [def-weil-pbc-etale-hypercover], and S_m a sieve on K_m for each m. If S_0 is covering, there exists a finite split replacement stage A through zero [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-replacement-stage] satisfying StageSolves K S A [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-local-replacement-stage].

source.place: Lemma 25.12.2 (0DAV), initial split stage; Lemmas 25.7.3 (01GJ) and 25.12.6 (094K), finite covering with prescribed local lifts.

proof.text: The degree-zero matching universal property of K has an empty cone. Apply it to id_X to obtain a section of the matching object over X. This makes the matching object surjective over X. The matching arrow from K_0 is surjective, so K_0 to X is surjective.

Apply the finite prescribed-sieve covering lemma to E=K_0, M=X, e its structure map, and R=S_0. Its output is a finite affine coproduct T, a map t:T to K_0, surjective structure map T to X, and a finite cofan whose composites with t lie in S_0.

Use the constant degree-zero truncated functor on T. Set N_0=T with identity inclusion, and use X as its terminal matching object. There is only one degree-zero surjection, so the canonical cofan is the identity colimit. Its matching surjectivity is that of T to X. The unique operators of the zero truncation define its refinement to K using t. The chosen cofan from the previous step proves StageSolves; its extra identity simplicial operator disappears by K.map_id.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_local_replacement_stage_zero
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (K : SimplicialObject X.Etale) (hK : IsEtaleHypercover K)
    (S : ∀ n : ℕ, Sieve (K.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))))
    (hS : S 0 ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology _) :
    ∃ A : FiniteSplitReplacementStage K 0, StageSolves K S A
